'''Aldera''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was located near the [[Triplehorn mountains]], nestled on an island at the center of a [[Aldera lake|lake]]. In addition to being the planet's seat of power, Aldera was also an important center of culture and science, comprising the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]], several musea and the famous cooking school of the [[Epicurium]]. However, it was destroyed in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] along with the rest of Alderaan, when the Empire saw an opportunity to break in its new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

==Geography==
{{Quote|The glittering capital city of Aldera sat on an island in the center of a beautiful lake.|[[Hari Seldona]]|<ref name="ISWU" />}}
[[File:MCQ-aldera.png|thumb|left|250px|The gleaming Aldera]]
The city of Aldera was built on an island<ref name="RoDV" /> with uneven slopes located in the middle of a [[Aldera lake|lake]]. That lake was in fact a relatively fresh [[Asteroid/Legends|meteor]] crater&mdash;from a geological point of view, as most of Alderaan's ancient craters had been weathered away&mdash;which had broken through into the underground aquifers<ref name="ISWU" /> around [[30,500 BBY]].<ref name="FF18">According to [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 18|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 18]], the crater formed roughly three thousands [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the arrival of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places around [[27,500 BBY]].</ref> The resulting body of [[Water/Legends|water]] was surrounded by a series of low foothill areas covered with woodlands and green fields.<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> One of the city's edges was bordered by the [[Triplehorn mountains]],<ref name="swcw" /> the top of which was often shrouded in snow.<ref name="RoDV" /> In the morning light, the waters of Aldera's lake shone a sparkling icy-blue.<ref name="TPS" /> Across the water from the city lay a vast wilderness that was quite close to Aldera, although not part of it. That zone of grasslands contained a small valley from which one could get a glimpse of the capital in the distance.<ref name="LoJ:R">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref>

Like the other few metropolitan areas of the planet, Aldera was designed in such way that the natural landscape was little affected. With its gleaming white, free-form buildings standing on the uneven slopes of the island, the skyline of Aldera created an artful bridge between the green fields and white clouds.<ref name="OldDB">{{DB|location|alderaan|Alderaan}}</ref> The climate around Aldera was usually temperate,<ref name="LJMoD" /> without excluding occasional light snow.<ref name="ST:AC" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Aldera_Palace_balcony.png|thumb|250px|A view on the Royal Palace's balcony]]
{{Quote|Aldera housed the embassies of off-planet dignitaries, and was also the home of Senator Bail Organa. Princess Leia Organa spent many years of her childhood there.|Hari Seldona|<ref name="ISWU" />}}
Visitors to the city mostly arrived by air, unless they traversed the lake by boat.<ref name="ISWU" /> Upon reaching Aldera, many outlanders were breathtaken at the white, flowing architecture of the buildings, many of them belonging to the planetary government.<ref name="TPS" /> The most majestic of Aldera's monuments was the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]], which housed [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] and her consort, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="RoDV" /> While the Palace's towers were high and occupied a wide stretch of ground, some of the buildings located west of them were tall enough to obstruct the view.<ref name="RFH">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

In addition to being the royal seat of Alderaan, the capital city was also home to the main core of the most prestigious [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]]<ref name="ISWU" /> and the most high-tech [[Aldera Universal Medcenter]].<ref name="CCW" /> On a more mundane level, the city also contained a [[Spacer Quarter]]&mdash;in which many bars and hotels could be found<ref name="CCW" />&mdash;and a marketplace.<ref name="RFH" /> The planet's primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was also located in the outskirts of Aldera.<ref name="CCW" /> The spaceport's main docking facility was hosted in a cluster of hemispherical buildings.<ref name="SG">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Aldera-StarTours.png|thumb|left|250px|A Star Tours shuttle landing at Aldera]]
The city of Aldera, the ancient capital of Alderaan, dated back to the founding of many of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] oldest learning institutions.<ref name="ISWU" /> The city was specifically built inside a meteor crater filled with water in order to minimize its impact on the planet's surface.<ref name="BMF11">{{BuildFalconCite|11|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> The University of Alderaan, established by the renowned [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] [[Collus (philosopher)|Collus]], was one of the first structures built on the island city—and one of the oldest and most widely revered [[University/Legends|universities]] in the galaxy.<ref name="ISWU" />

Although Aldera was perhaps best known for its university, many other prominent buildings housed the cultural and governmental facilities which Alderaan was so well known for. Over time, as powerful individuals seized on the University of Alderaan's importance, other teachers came to Alderaan to build their own schools in Aldera, adjacent to the original university. These institutions branched into disciplines including politics, mathematics, cultural pursuits, and the arts.<ref name="ISWU" />

Aldera housed the embassies of off-world dignitaries<ref name="ISWU" /> and would eventually become the political heart of Alderaan. The Aldera Royal Palace was constructed in the planetary capital shortly before [[719 BBY/Legends|719 BBY]],<ref name="RoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> some two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Prior to this, at least until the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] of [[3653 BBY]], the [[Elysium]] had been the planet's political center.<ref name="TOR codex: Elysium">{{TORcite|type=codex|Elysium}}</ref>

At some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="ST2 date">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency organized trips to Alderaan as part of their [[Star Tours Getaway Package]]. The company's [[StarSpeeder 1000]] spacecrafts would notably bring their passengers to the capital city of Aldera. At that time, Alderaan was considered the safest planet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="COM">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/celebration_v_startourspromo/index.html|text=New Star Tours "Commercial"}}</ref> However, the city was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]], along with the rest of Alderaan, by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in 0 BBY.<ref name="ANH" />

Tens of thousands of Alderaanians had been off planet when it was blown up, allowing them to survive. Gradually, the disparate groups of survivors<ref name="RFH" /> ended up forming the [[Alderaan Alliance]]<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> and moved to [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]]. On their new world, the refugees built [[New Aldera]], an exact replica of their lost capital.<ref name="DEII">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Aldera was first designed by [[Ralph McQuarrie]], who was the conceptual designer responsible for the look of the [[original trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]''.<ref name="ISWU" /> The mountains surrounding Aldera in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] were modelled after a location in the [[Wikipedia:Swiss Alps|Swiss Alps]].<ref name="AoSWIII">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>
